description.fallback: As the mine cart spirals deeper into the cave, Wamuu tries to understand why Joseph is sacrificing himself. He guesses Joseph's plan and hits the brakes before Joseph does, sending both flying and also guesses that his enemy plans to use the stick of dynamite behind him, spoiling Joseph's plans. They crash into a court under Esidisi and Kars's watch.
